audience.role: Plugin users, upgraders from 0.6.1, and security reviewers evaluating the 0.7.0 candidate

checks.note: README explains fit, install and first run per locale; changelogs record version differences; bilingual release notes explain the upgrade; SECURITY.md scopes the risk decision.

A new reader reaches registry and reviewed-source install paths plus a working first-run command in their own locale; all three READMEs state three shipped locales with Russian first-class, no source-only framing.
Resume, deterministic caches, locales and cleanup terms are introduced before use; upgrade statements agree that 0.6.1 runs stay resumable and no new analysis run is required for this upgrade.
Historical 0.6.1 exception, current unauthorized_findings status with publication block, and explicit non-claims (reachability, trigger probability) stay separated; anchors used by readers exist.
Identity 0.7.0, rc.5 primary / rc.2 floor, locale lists, Node engines and dev-command blocks agree across languages before deeper detail appears.
The Russian README is fully translated with no untranslated paragraphs; Chinese changelog and Chinese release-notes sections read independently of the English text.

limitations: Cold read covers reader comprehension of the frozen bytes; native host, real-model, GUI and publication checks are separate gates recorded in docs/acceptance/v0.7.0-candidate.md and remain pending or separately recorded.
The release notes reference the candidate acceptance record by its in-repository path; the published Release body will link the path as it exists at the release tag.
